title: Competitive equilibrium for almost all budgets with two additive agents
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: For every finite goods instance with two agents and positive additive valuations, does a competitive equilibrium exist for Lebesgue-almost every positive pair of budgets?
context:
Use the ordinary indivisible-goods demand and market-clearing model; approximate equilibrium and equal-budget existence are different questions.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Tests whether a small asymmetry in purchasing power is enough to recover equilibrium with indivisible goods.
